miko: Quick question on Dataset Import modal: where should hints live vs inline errors? Also deletion UX: typed-confirm vs undo for row deletes? jamal: My vote: persistent helper text for examples/limits; inline errors only after blur/submit. sara: Accessibility: asterisk+caveat isnt enough. Use aria-required="true" + aria-describedby to helper. laura: Example snippet:
CSV or JSON, max 200MB
ethan: For deletes: typed-confirm for dataset-level irreversible deletes; row deletes = confirm + undo toast. sara: Add risk tiers to patterns doc: low=inline+undo, medium=modal+checkbox, high=typed-confirm. miko: Action items: jamal update Figma with helper variants; ethan add sensitiveDeletion flag to API; laura add focus trap + not auto-focus confirm; sara write risk-tier bullets. design-bot: Figma uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/import-modal-v5
